items.title: Trend Lines Beyond Weight
items.why:
Your note on review 6: trend lines would help other stats too. These are the stats Goku already records over time:

• Strength: reps per minute per workout, calories, protein, training minutes
• Gymnastics: readiness, training load, calories, protein

Gymnastics never shows weight, as before. Numbers in the mockups are made up.

options.label: A small line inside each Stats tile
options.desc: Last Session gets its last 8 workouts; Food Today its last 7 days, with the average. Nothing new to tap.

options.label: One Trends card with a picker
options.desc: One bigger chart; tap Reps/Min, Calories, Protein or Minutes to switch. Labels would be shortened to fit.

options.label: Both
options.desc: Small lines in the tiles, plus the Trends card for a closer look.

items.title: Your Review 6 Picks Are Built
items.why:
Built and tested in a local phone-size browser, not yet published: the workout-name fix, the weight trend with goal tracking, the last-time line, plate math (bar and plates are set in the exercise editor), one level picker, and the five small fixes. Also fixed: “Fuel Timing for When You Train” is now “Fuel Timing”, which review 5 had asked for and 2.9.0 missed.

Still not checked on an iPhone or the simulator.
